summary: Rewrote the makefile fragments (generated version.h rule, order-only and dependency-file tracking, flag stamp for DEBUG/release switching, static linking with libs last, strict check, install of both man pages and a pc file written at install time), removed the stale checked-in include/qs/ops.h, and fixed all warnings in the code (including prefix-minus precedence, size-suffix overflow and format specifiers). Verified clean builds at -j16 for every target, make check in release and debug, incremental rebuilds, and install into a staging DESTDIR.
